§3Curvy Pipes§r are pipes that do not have to follow the block grid. They bend, run diagonally and hang in midair, and they can carry items, fluids or a redstone signal depending on the variant. In this pack several variants are crafted from NTM ducts, so they need NTM materials.

- Hold a curvy pipe and click a block (or into the air) to start a pipe, then click where it should end. More clicks add nodes in between, and nodes can later be branched, moved or deleted.
- The cost depends on the pipe length and is shown before you place it.
- Every end attached to a block can be §6Passive§r, §6Extract§r (pushes into connected passive ends) or §6Retrieve§r (pulls from them). Right-click an end to configure it.
- Ends have filters (items, fluids or regex on the name), regulation limits to keep a fixed amount in an inventory, and an interval setting.

§2Transfer is instant - the pipe has no internal buffer.
